payout_quote: DirectPlus Checking: Set up and receive a new Direct Deposit totaling $500 or more per month and maintain a minimum daily balance of $500 for 90 days and receive a one time bonus of $300. Must be new money and new direct deposit to the bank. One bonus per customer will be paid if conditions are met. Bonus may be taxable. All other service charges apply.
steps: Confirm you live in Schertz Bank & Trust's Texas service area.
Open a new DirectPlus Checking account.
Set up and receive a new direct deposit totaling $500 or more per month.
Maintain a minimum daily balance of $500 for 90 days.
Receive the one-time $300 bonus once conditions are met.
catches: Must be NEW money and a NEW direct deposit to the bank.
Maintain $500 minimum daily balance for 90 days - no dips allowed.
The bonus is generally treated as taxable income; consult a tax advisor - general bank-bonus tax treatment, not stated in the captured official terms.
DirectPlus has a $5 monthly service charge if the $500 minimum daily balance is not maintained - but the bonus requires maintaining that balance, so the fee is avoided during the 90-day period.
biggest_catch: You must be a NEW customer with new money, receive $500+ in direct deposits per month, AND maintain a $500 minimum daily balance for 90 days with no dips.
